Messages.Author: the1andonlime
Messages.Body:
How does Hagar Stone interact with cards that require you to discard cards from your hand?
Do you replace them?

If you do replace them, I supposed it's not an issue with cards like The Barrens, but it's a book keeping nightmare for cards that require you to discard your hand (e.g. Legion)

> Name: Hagar Stone
> Capacity: 6
> Type: Vampire
> Group: 5
> Clan: Malkavian antitribu
> Disciplines: obf AUS DEM
> Set/Rarity: SoC:V
> Artist: Ken Meyer, Jr.
> CardText: Sabbat. Black Hand: While Hagar is ready, you have +1 hand size. While Hagar is untapped, do not replace cards you play on your turn until Hagar taps or your turn ends.
>

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Hagar's special affects only cards "you play". Cards that are discarded with The Barrens for instance are not played, thus you replace them by default.
If you want to play Legion, you don't replace it, you discard the rest of your hand (say 6 cards) and draw back as many cards (6)
